name: app-harbor-ai-support-app-extra-long-case-study
title: AI Support App Extra-Long Case Study
whatItIs: An extremely tall white case-study page for a support-agent app: ghost 'Harbor' lettering above a phone lock screen, project overview, app-icon closeups, a challenge section with red problem cards, wireframes, solution phones, a happy-path flow, a strategy plan and categorised work queues.
whatItMeans: A long, calm sequence of alternating text and device images tells a full design story at an editorial pace.
techniques: Giant ghost brand name behind the hero device
Section labels in tiny caps with large statements beside
Red-outlined problem cards connected by dotted lines
Wireframes shown before final UI to show process
Dark gloved hand holding the phone for contrast

vocabulary.definition: A card stating a specific issue the design solves.
The ideal sequence a user follows to complete a task.
A tiny caption naming the stage of a case study.
